name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper Standard AI Addendum. Governs AI services offered as part of a product, including permitted use of inputs and outputs, restrictions on regulated decision-making, and default prohibitions on model training unless the cover page allows it.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement. Sets HIPAA obligations for providers handling protected health information, including permitted uses and disclosures, security programs, breach notification, and subcontractor terms.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement. Core terms for providing and consuming a cloud service: access and use rights, support, customer data, security, confidentiality, IP, liability, and compliance.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement. Grants a partner early access to a product in development in exchange for structured feedback and participation in the provider's design program.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement. Data processing terms for controller/processor relationships, covering subprocessors, international transfers, security measures, and personal data incident response.

name: Mutual NDA Standard Terms
description: Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms (v1.0). The standard terms portion of a mutual non-disclosure agreement: definition and protection of confidential information, permitted disclosures, and term. Pairs with the Mutual NDA Cover Page.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Common Paper Mutual NDA Cover Page. Fill-in cover page that, together with the Mutual NDA Standard Terms, forms a complete mutual non-disclosure agreement; cover page entries control over conflicting standard terms.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement. Framework for commercial cooperation between two businesses, covering obligations, payments, intellectual property, confidentiality, and governance of the partnership.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement. Terms for customer evaluation of a product during a pilot period, including access rights, evaluation-purpose-only use, feedback ownership, and conversion to a paid subscription.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement. Terms for licensing on-premises or downloaded software: license grant, permitted uses, support, customer data, IP, and subscription/term mechanics.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement. Terms under which a provider delivers consulting or professional services via statements of work, including cooperation, change orders, acceptance, and IP in deliverables.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement. Defines target uptime for a cloud service, how availability is calculated, support response commitments, and service credits for missed targets.
